scope: Synthetic pairwise identity-policy regression corpus, independently labeled from the safety requirements. Not a measured real-library accuracy sample. Rejected candidates are unresolved identity proposals, not identified songs.

cases.name: exact_identity
cases.reason: Exact recording text agrees.

cases.name: case_difference
cases.reason: Case does not change identity.

cases.name: accent_normalization
cases.reason: Canonical diacritic normalization preserves identity.

cases.name: unicode_apostrophe
cases.reason: Typographic punctuation is equivalent.

cases.name: duration_equal
cases.reason: Text and duration agree.

cases.name: duration_at_boundary
cases.reason: The default tolerance includes exactly two seconds.

cases.name: duration_past_boundary
cases.reason: A known duration mismatch outside tolerance rejects the proposal.

cases.name: duration_shorter_outside_boundary
cases.reason: Duration evidence is symmetric.

cases.name: unknown_candidate_duration
cases.reason: Absent duration is not conflicting duration evidence.

cases.name: unknown_expected_duration
cases.reason: Available text can match without a local duration.

cases.name: short_title_collision
cases.reason: Short fuzzy strings must not collide.

cases.name: short_exact_title
cases.reason: Short exact text is legitimate.

cases.name: short_artist_collision
cases.reason: Different short artist names cannot be fuzzily merged.

cases.name: different_artist
cases.reason: A common title does not establish artist identity.

cases.name: different_title
cases.reason: An artist has multiple distinct recordings.

cases.name: series_number_conflict
cases.reason: Different numbered parts are separate recordings.

cases.name: series_number_missing
cases.reason: A numbered continuation is not the unnumbered title.

cases.name: remix_versus_original
cases.reason: Remix identity must be preserved.

cases.name: live_versus_studio
cases.reason: A live rendition is a different recording.

cases.name: instrumental_versus_vocal
cases.reason: Instrumental versions cannot replace vocal versions.

cases.name: different_remixers
cases.reason: Different remix modifiers identify different versions.

cases.name: missing_expected_title
cases.reason: Missing title supplies no recording identity evidence.

cases.name: missing_candidate_title
cases.reason: A provider must supply a candidate title.

cases.name: different_featured_artists
cases.reason: Distinct featured artists represent distinct editions and must not collapse.
